root_cause.text: btintel_hw_error() invokes __hci_cmd_sync() without holding hci_req_sync_lock, allowing a race with btintel_shutdown_combined() (which holds the lock) to concurrently manipulate hdev->req_rsp, resulting in a use-after-free when the close path frees the response skb while the hardware error path still accesses it.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message and KASAN report confirm the data race between __hci_cmd_sync_sk (reading req_rsp) and btintel_shutdown_combined (writing/freeing req_rsp), and the patch adds hci_req_sync_lock/unlock to serialize the entire recovery sequence.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix hardware error handling by acquiring hci_req_sync lock before reset command and ensuring lock release on error path.
intent_record.what: Added hci_req_sync_lock(hdev) before __hci_cmd_sync and changed return to goto unlock in case of error.
intent_record.how: Ensures the hci_req_sync lock is acquired before sending the reset command and released on all exit paths (both success and failure).

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix lock leak in btintel_hw_error by ensuring hci_req_sync_unlock is called on all exit paths.
intent_record.what: Replaced early return statements with goto to a unified unlock label that calls hci_req_sync_unlock, and added the unlock call after the normal path.
intent_record.how: Ensures the lock acquired before the function is released in all exit paths, preventing a lock leak that would cause deadlock or resource issues.
